rules.name: Denied Prohibited Destructive Action by AI Agent
rules.description: Triggers when an autonomous coding agent attempts to execute an unpermitted destructive command (e.g. recursive deletion, database wipe, cloud teardown).
rules.condition: outcome == 'DENY' AND (act IN ['rm -rf', 'drop database', 'aws s3 rm', 'terraform destroy', 'truncate'])
rules.playbook: Verify developer session, inspect task proposal lineage in BAP Mission Control, revoke session if unapproved.

rules.name: Honeytoken Canary Exfiltration Tripped
rules.description: Triggers when an agent process attempts to read or transmit a planted BAP tripwire honeytoken (.bap_canary_token / CORP_CANARY_TOKEN).
rules.playbook: Immediate automated session freeze; isolate agent runtime host and initiate compromised credential sweep.

rules.name: Unmediated Shell or Socket Bypass Attempt
rules.description: Triggers when an agent process attempts to bypass BAP Edge mediation using raw network sockets, proxy environment unsets, or direct curls.
rules.playbook: Inspect command ancestry tree; ensure Windows restricted token / Landlock boundary contained the breakout.

rules.name: Scope Escalation Attempt in OAuth 2.0 Token Exchange
rules.description: Triggers when an RFC 8693 token exchange request specifies scopes exceeding the authorized proposal grant boundary.
rules.condition: event_type == 'TOKEN_EXCHANGE_DENIED' AND msg CONTAINS 'privilege escalation blocked'
rules.playbook: Review agent task scope; investigate whether prompt injection induced the agent to request broader administrative authority.

rules.name: Unattested Workload or SPIFFE Identity Mismatch
rules.description: Triggers when a request presents an unregistered SPIFFE ID, expired SVID, or invalid certificate serial.
rules.playbook: Block workload enrollment; check endpoint attestation TPM / platform posture; verify binary hash integrity.
